description: This file provides AVX2 optimized functions for packing and unpacking 16-bit IQ samples in various formats (9-bit big-endian, 16-bit big-endian) for use in signal processing, specifically for resource blocks in wireless communication. It includes functions for packing IQ samples into compact byte representations and unpacking them back into 16-bit signed integers, utilizing AVX2 intrinsics for performance.

methods.name: pack_avx2_register_9b_be
methods.description: Pack 16-bit IQ samples into an AVX2 register using 9-bit big-endian format, processing each 128-bit lane to produce 18 packed bytes.

methods.name: avx2_pack_prbs_9b_big_endian
methods.description: Pack two resource blocks' 16-bit IQ samples into 9-bit big-endian format, producing 27 bytes per block.

methods.name: avx2_pack_prbs_16b_big_endian
methods.description: Pack two resource blocks' 16-bit IQ samples into 16-bit big-endian format, producing 48 bytes per block.

methods.name: pack_prbs_big_endian
methods.description: Dispatch function to pack IQ samples into either 9-bit or 16-bit big-endian format based on specified width.

methods.name: avx2_unpack_prb_9b_be
methods.description: Unpack 9-bit big-endian packed IQ samples from 27 bytes into 16-bit signed integers.

methods.name: avx2_unpack_prb_16b_be
methods.description: Unpack 16-bit big-endian packed IQ samples from 48 bytes into 16-bit signed integers.

methods.name: unpack_prb_big_endian
methods.description: Dispatch function to unpack IQ samples from either 9-bit or 16-bit big-endian format based on specified width.

methods.name: iq_width_packing_supported
methods.description: Check if the specified IQ bit width (9 or 16) is supported by the AVX2 implementation.
